name: virlow
description: Connects Codex to Virlow, your end-to-end encrypted notes, and makes memory automatic: recall at the start of a task and a reminder to save what was learned.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Virlow, the end-to-end encrypted workspace for notes and connected ideas. Codex recalls what Virlow knows about your project at the start of a task, and is reminded to save durable facts you share before it stops.
defaultPrompt: What does Virlow remember about this project?
